versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00003, SRS_Rte_00004, SRS_Rte_ 00045 void SchM_[<client>_]<api>Hook_<bsnp>_[<vi>_<ai>] _<name>_Terminate (<param>) Where <api> is the BSW Scheduler API Name (i.e. Switch) w.r.t mode switch initiation, <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix according to [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module, <ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module and <name> is the provided ( providedModeGroup ) ModeDeclara- tionGroupPrototype name. The parameters of the API shall be the same as the corresponding BSW Scheduler API. See [SWS_Rte_07255]. 856 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 The sub part in square brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module. See [SWS_Rte_07528].
